problem.heading: Your counsellors are running a call center, not selling placements.
problem.sub: The contact form collects data but creates no intelligence. The discovery call creates intelligence but doesn't scale.
problem.point1Desc: Counsellors spend most of their time re-collecting information a parent already typed into a form, a document, or a voice note somewhere — before any real conversation starts.
problem.point2Desc: Most enquiries never get a response at all, because there's no way to triage volume without burning the same counsellor hours on every single one.
problem.point3Desc: Only a small fraction convert — and there's no way to tell which of the rest were worth chasing until it's already too late.

services.heading: Six steps from enquiry to counsellor handoff.
services.sub: Every step builds a structured profile automatically — no manual triage required.
services.step1Desc: A short form captures the basics — child's age, school type, target geography — in under 60 seconds.
services.step2Desc: Parents share everything they've already collected: voice notes, research documents, brochures, PDFs, screenshots. Any format.
services.step3Desc: An agent transcribes audio, extracts facts from documents, and identifies preferences, constraints, and priorities automatically.
services.step4Desc: The parent sees their own profile and can correct or refine it — their scattered research, validated and organized.
services.step5Desc: The profile is scored 0–100 across Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline, then routed automatically.
services.step5Band1: < 35 — Low fit: automated resources, no counsellor time spent
services.step5Band2: 35–50 — Unclear fit: AI asks targeted follow-ups to sharpen the score
services.step5Band3: 50–75 — Qualified: booking link + email introduction to a counsellor
services.step5Band4: 75–100 — Hot lead: priority alert, counsellor responds within 2 hours
services.step6Desc: The counsellor receives a pre-built profile, not a blank form. The first conversation starts at “here's what we recommend.”

outcomes.heading: What changes on day one.
outcomes.sub: Counsellors open their day with a ranked list of parents sorted by fit, not a pile of unread forms.
outcomes.stopHeading: What the agency no longer does
outcomes.stopItem2: Spend discovery calls collecting information the parent already has
outcomes.stopItem3: Maintain separate notes across email, spreadsheets, and memory
outcomes.stopItem4: Guess which leads are worth calling back first
outcomes.gainItem1: Every counsellor-hour spent on a parent who is likely to convert
outcomes.gainItem2: A system that works across devices, counsellors, and time zones
outcomes.gainItem3: An institutional memory that doesn't leave when a counsellor does
outcomes.gainItem4: A dashboard that filters and sorts by score, school type, geography, and timeline

credibility.heading: We're not asking you to trust a black box.
credibility.sub: No customer logos yet — Lawrence is early. Here's the mechanism instead, so you can judge it on how it works, not who else uses it.
credibility.mechanism1Desc: Filter and sort every active profile by score band, school type, geography, or timeline. Drill into any parent to see the full AI-constructed summary, uploaded documents, and extracted signals.
credibility.mechanism2Title: Notes that feed the profile back
credibility.mechanism2Desc: Meeting notes, voice memos, and follow-up documents a counsellor adds get folded back into the profile automatically — keeping it current without duplicating work.
credibility.mechanism3Desc: When 40 parents in a quarter ask about bilingual IB programmes in Switzerland, that pattern surfaces in aggregate — feeding website content, counsellor talking points, and school-partner conversations.

cta.heading: See your intake funnel qualified before your next call.
cta.sub: 30 minutes. We walk through the BANT rubric against your actual enquiry volume and show you what a scored, profiled lead looks like before it reaches a counsellor.
cta.proofLine: No demo video — we run the intake flow live against a real enquiry scenario.
